description: Rolled when a Hiver career Event roll results in 'A Life Event occurs'. Roll 2D.

2.title: Injury
2.text: You were injured in an accident or perhaps even by violence. Roll on the Hiver Injury Table.

3.title: Deficiency Disease
3.text: You suffered a deficiency disease which took its toll on your health. Lose 1 point from any characteristic, determined randomly.

4.title: Relationship Collapses
4.text: Your previously good relationship with someone — this may be another Hiver or someone from outside the Hive Federation — collapses. It was probably your fault for manipulating them too hard but you will not admit that. Gain an Enemy.

5.title: Work Clashes
5.text: Your work clashes with that of another individual, leading to friction. Despite your attempts to resolve the situation or modify their thinking they remain unreasonably opposed to you. Gain a Rival.

6.title: Useful Alliance
6.text: You meet someone useful and manipulate them into thinking they owe you their loyalty. Gain an Ally.

7.title: New Connections
7.text: You make some useful connections. Gain a Contact.

8.title: Plotting Discovered
8.text: Someone was plotting behind your back! You discovered their intentions to make you their puppet and are now wary of them. Convert one Ally or Contact into a Rival. If you have no Allies or Contacts, gain an Enemy.

9.title: New Knowledge
9.text: You travel and gain new knowledge, which can be used to your advantage. Gain +2 on your next advancement check.

10.title: Nest Change
10.text: You change nests. This is a golden opportunity to shed some of your previous negative credit. Gain one additional Benefits cash roll.

11.title: Great Manipulator
11.text: You are fortunate to meet a great Manipulator, who shares some secrets with you. You gain a level of Deception, Diplomat or Persuade.

12.title: Manipulator's Gift
12.text: You are fortunate to meet a great Manipulator, who shares some secrets with you. You realise it would not do such a thing without a goal in mind. Perhaps the Manipulator recognised your potential and wanted to help but more likely it has a plan for you. Either way, you gain RES +1 and a general feeling of paranoia.
